manualFollowUps: After an authorized PR merge and successful Pages deploy, verify the linked production project and pending migrations before supabase db push --linked. Review unrelated pending migrations separately.
Deploy supabase functions deploy academy --project-ref <verified-production-project>. No new secrets.
Complete authenticated owner, scoped teacher and learner acceptance in a designated test academy before accepting bookings. Check cross-tenant denial.
verification: Run npm run test:academy:assessments, Academy lint, i18n, routes, Edge contracts/typecheck, both builds, verify:academy and verify:prod.
Verify registration without enrollment, timed save/restore, deadline rejection, review, release, report persistence and enrollment using authorized production test accounts.
Check English, Uzbek and Russian at phone and desktop widths, and confirm printed reports exclude unrelated records.

rollback.frontends: Roll back schood-academy and schood-academy-docs Pages to the previous known-good commit in Cloudflare; never deploy Pages locally.
rollback.edgeFunctions: Stop new assessment starts and redeploy the previous known-good academy Edge Function from its exact commit.
rollback.database: Retain additive tables and all submitted evidence. Do not drop assessment data; existing Academy flows do not depend on the new tables.
